items.name: Athens Summer Break A 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnA1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07e81cdd5b508271bf1d27c0c873b462bead0340/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2 και OH ή Pyraminx και Skewb επιθυμείτε. Πέντε διαγωνισμοί για τα μισά του 2024 δεν είναι αρκετοί. Απλά δεν είναι! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Athens Summer Break A 2024. ** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * OH, επίλυση 3x3 με ένα χέρι Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 2x2 and OH or Pyraminx and Skewb you prefer. Five competitions for the half of 2024! Amazing! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. items.information: (SRB) Belgrade Summer 2024 je dvadeseto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koliko dana se takmičite. Ukoliko se takmičite oba dana plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD, ali ukoliko se takmičite samo 1 dan plaćate 50% iznosa. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.** ------------------------ (ENG) Belgrade Summer 2024 is the 20th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **Registration fee for this competition depends on how many days you are competing on. If you are competing on both days you will pay the full fee of 2,000RSD, but if you are competing only on one day you will pay 50%. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

items.information: ## Information [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Big & Blind Pretoria 2024! This competition is focused on the the bigger NxNs like 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 and blind events! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. If you are competing in multi-blind, please make sure to arrive between 07:30-07:45 for cube submission. ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any competitor or competitor's guest is willing to help judge with the blind events, especially multi-blind, please let us know. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Ilulissat 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png) * This is the first speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Ilulissat! * The competition happens on Saturday 15 June in the afternoon (13 to 16), but a workshop will happen the morning (9 ti 12) and the day before, Friday 14 from 13 to 17. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Saturday afternoon! * The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png) * Una Ilulissani speedcubingimik unammisitsineq siullerpaajuvoq World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaq! * Unammineq arfininngornermi 15. juni ualikkut nal. 13:00-16:00 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq tallimanngornermi 14. juni nal. 13:00-17:00 aamma arfininngornermi 15. juni nal. 09:00-12:00 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Arfininngornermi ualikkut periutsinik nutaanik ilinniarnissannut nuannersumut peqatigisigut Cube-ertartut allat peqatigalugit, imminullu time-lersornermut piareersarlutit. * Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit aggeqqutissaatit piffissalersussallutillu, angusanni pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu ilanngaatigeriarlugit sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnerat unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissinneqarumaarpoq. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terning-ip naammassisinnaanngornissaa, tamanna pillugu pikkorissanermi ikiorumaarpatsigit. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png) * Dette er den første speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i ilulissat! * Konkurrencen finder sted lørdag den 15. juni om eftermiddagen kl. 13:00-16:00, før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop fredag den 14. fra kl. 13:00-17:00 og lørdag fra kl. 09:00-12:00. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv lørdag eftermiddag. * Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0Z0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0b41adcf5d4f6f1ea7f7c8838508e1b81430c53/1.png) # **SeaHorse Vallarta 2024** **Español** ¡Bienvenidos a SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, la primera competencia celebrada en Puerto Vallarta! Es un honor darles la bienvenida a este emocionante evento donde los aficionados al cubo de Rubik de diversas partes del país podran convivir en este bello puerto y poder demostrar sus habilidades y rapidez. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **Ingles** ¡Welcome to SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, the first competition held in Puerto Vallarta! It is an honor to welcome you to this exciting event where Rubik Cube fans from different parts of the country will be able to coexist in this beautiful port and demonstrate their skills and speed. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

items.name: Trondheim Friends 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Friends 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Friends 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.
